'''Mietek Jaroniec''' (born 1 January 1949) is a Polish and American [[chemist]] and an author of over 950 scientific papers, which got over 127,964 citations and brings him an [[h-index]] of 155.<ref name=uq>{{cite web|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=frukVO4AAAAJ&hl=en|title=Mietek Jaroniec, Google Scholar|pages=1–3|accessdate=June 28, 2023}}</ref>

==Biography==
He was born in 1949 in [[Okrzeja]], Poland. He obtained his masters and Ph.D. degrees in [[chemistry]] at the [[Curie-Sklodowska University]] in 1972 and 1976 respectively. From 1972 to 1991 he worked at the Department of Theoretical Chemistry, Marie Curie-Sklodowska University and since 1991 works at [[Kent State University]] as a professor. Prior to it, he also was a research assistant from 1972 to 1977 after which he got promoted to the assistant professor a position that he kept till 1980. From 1980 to 1985 he was an associate professor and then climbed the career ladder to become [[professor]] at which he remained till 1989.<ref name=uq/>

==Publications==
From 1981 to 1986 he served as an editor of the ''[[Thin Solid Films]]'' and from 1985 to the same year was ''[[Journal of Colloid Interface Science]]'' editor. He also served as an editor of ''[[Heterogeneous Chemistry Reviews]]'' from 1994 to 1997 and is currently edits such journals as the ''[[Journal of Liquid Chromatography]]'', ''[[Journal of Porous Materials]]'', among others.<ref name=uq/>

==Awards==
In 1997 he was awarded by the [[Japan Society for the Promotion of Science]] and in 2001 became a recipient of the ''Carbon Hall of Fame Award''. In 2007, for his achievements, he was awarded ''A. Waksmundzki Medal'' from the [[Polish Chemical Society]]<ref name=uq/> and then got an [[honorary degree]] from [[Nicolaus Copernicus University]] on February 19, 2009<ref>{{cite web|url=http://einside.kent.edu/?type=art&id=91614|title=Kent State Professor Recognized Internationally as Leading Chemist|publisher=Kent State University|accessdate=December 21, 2013}}</ref> and in 2010 from  [[Military Technical University]].<ref>{{cite news|url= https://www.kent.edu/news/newsdetail.cfm?newsitem=D708CDCD-EA88-763D-BC0BE33AF4DCAF94|title=Professor Awarded a Second Doctor of Honoris Causa|publisher=Kent State University|date=February 16, 2010|accessdate=December 21, 2013}}</ref> In 2016, he received the [[Marie Curie Medal]] by the Polish Chemical Society.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.kent.edu/flash-feed/news/kent-state-chemistry-professor-awarded-marie-sklodowska-curie-medal-poland |title=KENT STATE CHEMISTRY PROFESSOR AWARDED THE MARIE SKLODOWSKA-CURIE MEDAL IN POLAND |website=kent.edu |access-date=21 April 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web| url = http://www.ptchem.pl/nagrody/laureaci-medali-ptchem |language = pl |title=Laureaci medali Polskiego Towarzystwa Chemicznego |archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20180831144808/http://www.ptchem.pl/nagrody/laureaci-medali-ptchem | access-date = 28 September 2021|archive-date = 2018-08-31 }}</ref>
